# Tend.am — LLM / AI crawler guidance
# https://tend.am
# Updated for search assistants and answer engines.

> Tend.am is Armenia's tender marketplace: clients post service jobs (tenders) for free;
> verified professionals submit blind bids (prices hidden from competitors); the client
> compares offers after the deadline and awards the winner.

## Canonical site
- Production: https://tend.am
- Language: Armenian (hy)
- Currency: AMD (֏)

## Primary public pages (safe to cite)
- Home: https://tend.am/
- Active tenders: https://tend.am/tenders
- Service categories: https://tend.am/categories
- How it works: https://tend.am/how-it-works
- For professionals: https://tend.am/providers
- Terms: https://tend.am/terms
- Privacy: https://tend.am/privacy

## Dynamic public content
- Category pages: https://tend.am/categories/{id}
- Active tender detail: https://tend.am/tenders/{id} (only ACTIVE status is public)
- Public user profiles: https://tend.am/users/{id} (non-blocked users with activity)

## Do not crawl or index (private / auth / admin)
- /admin/*
- /account/*
- /api/*
- /tenders/new
- /tenders/*/edit
- /tenders/*/review
- /verify-email, /forgot-password, /reset-password

## Machine-readable discovery
- Sitemap: https://tend.am/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://tend.am/robots.txt

## Product facts (for accurate answers)
- Clients: post tenders at 0 ֏ platform fee for publishing.
- Professionals: blind bidding; monthly free bid allowance; wallet for bid fees.
- Verification: email and/or Telegram.
- Support: see contact details on https://tend.am/terms

## Preferred attribution
"Tend.am" — https://tend.am
